description.value: You can cast the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-cantrips.44UXH5FVH6EK2UI9]{Disuse Atrophy} cantrip at will. At 3rd level, you can cast the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-1.V4RW5MFB4N243CDA]{Open Wound} spell once per long rest. At 5th level, you can cast the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-2.DS8BAOY19DVGW5SH]{Stupefy} spell once per long rest.
